title: No title has the wavy line background: Wind Streams is taken out
goal: Some title pages draw a background of thin wavy lines drifting across the frame. The user finds it amateur, like bland wood grain, and wants it gone. Take that background out of every built-in title and out of the backgrounds a title can be restyled to, and give the titles that used it a quiet, refined ground instead.
notes: User, 2026-11-26, with a screenshot of the old Kinetic Bold mid swing transition in their 0.23.0 app: "this screen, the background is so freaking amateur. we need to just remove this. it's like some kind of bland wood grain". Their app was 0.23.0, but the 2026-11-21 redesign kept the same backdrop: Sources/PhotonzCore/TitleSet.swift:344 Condensed Poster `live(.windStreams, ground: "#0F0E0D", ...)` ('ember wind barely in it'). Backdrop: Sources/PhotonzCore/LiveBackdrop.swift (case windStreams, name 'Wind Streams', 'Line Weight' parameter), drawn in Sources/PhotonzRender/LiveBackdrops.swift:482, offered as a restyle at Sources/PhotonzCore/TitleRestyle.swift:246/255/272/765. Keep the enum case decodable for old documents (map it to the plain ground) rather than deleting it outright. Do not redesign the rest of Condensed Poster here; its headline running off the frame is a-main-title-headline-keeps-its-second-line-afte.
acceptance: Reproduced first at Next defaults: Condensed Poster (formerly Kinetic Bold) draws Wind Streams, wavy ember lines on warm black (queue/audits/2026-11-26-sizzle-intake/on-0.25-dev/dev-title-9s.png); the old Kinetic Bold drew the same in white on blue (the user's screenshot, 2026-11-26). List every built-in title and restyle option that draws it.

Wind Streams is no longer drawn by any built-in title page or name card, and is no longer offered as a background when restyling a title. Condensed Poster gets a plain ground in its own palette (warm black, at most a barely visible vignette or soft light falloff), chosen by the redesign task's rules (the title reference board from five-title-pages and seven-more-built-in-titles-look-as-refined), with a before and after picture.

Look at the other live backgrounds (energy streams, sketch, particles, grid horizon, liquid gradient) with the user's words in mind ('amateur', 'bland wood grain', 'clip art'), on a still and in motion, and write down in the audit which, if any, read the same way; take out only Wind Streams here and file the rest as one follow-up with pictures if any clear the follow-up bar.

Documents saved with a Wind Streams background still open: the title shows its replacement ground, nothing breaks, and a test proves it. Tests and walks that pin Wind Streams are updated, not left asserting it.

Audit with every changed title before and after. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: User, 2026-11-26: 'i would love for the sizzle reels to be saved somewhere so i can see samples'. Every reel this task makes (samples, before and after) goes through node queue/bin/reel-add.mjs so it shows on the dashboard's Reels page (http://127.0.0.1:8791/#reels) and in ~/Movies/Photonz Reels; the finished task leaves at least one sample there.
owns these walks: title-set-kinetic-bold-walk, live-title-backgrounds-walk, video-library-catalog-walk

Reproduced on main c3374bd6b at Next defaults: title-set-kinetic-bold-walk's export at 2.5s shows wavy ember lines on warm black behind Condensed Poster (queue/audits/2026-11-26-wind-streams-before-frame.png). Every user of Wind Streams: Condensed Poster's page (TitleSet.kinetic) was the only built-in title or name card; it was also offered in the title Background picker (TitleBackgroundKind.offered) and as a Library Catalog background tile (LiveLook.allCases), no chart used it.

Adversarial pass: a person who restyled a title to Wind Streams loses the lines; chose to open those on Solid in the ground the lines moved over (the notes' ask) over mapping to another moving look, because any other look would be a different picture they never picked. Chose a still radial warm black (#171513 behind the words falling to #0B0A09 at the corners) over a flat fill for Condensed Poster because the title rules ask for a ground with a temperature and the task allows a barely visible falloff; dropped the subtitle's shade, which only exists for moving looks (restyle puts it back if a look is picked).

Shipped: LiveLook.windStreams and its Metal kernel removed; LiveLook.retiredLooks lets Paint decode a saved Wind Streams paint as a solid at its first stop and TitleBackgroundKind decode windStreams as .solid. Condensed Poster now hasMovingBackdrop false. Tests: new WindStreamsRetiredTests (not offered, no preset draws it, Condensed Poster's still warm ground, old documents open/restyle/re-save clean, old paint and kind decode); LiveBackdropTests, TitleSetTests, TitleCalmSetTests updated from ten looks to nine. Walks: live-title-backgrounds-walk now expects no Wind Streams tile; notes in it and video-library-catalog-walk say nine. All three walks green; Scripts/test.sh green.

Pictures looked at: before-frame (lines visible across the frame), after-frame and after-holding-sc (no lines, still warm black, ivory and vermilion legible), a contrast-stretched after-frame (soft falloff, one-level 8-bit steps only visible at 8x stretch), picker-nine-looks-sc (nine looks, no Wind Streams), library catalog (Backgrounds 9). Reels registered: before and after on the Reels page. Other looks judged on queue/audits/2026-11-26-wind-streams-other-looks-sheet.png: Energy Streams, Grid Horizon, Color Bubbles read as stock clip art at tile strength; filed as the-library-and-title-restyle-stop-offering-back (p2: my judgement, not a user report). Rough items: the 8-bit steps and old documents getting plain solid stay in this log and the audit (below the bar); headline running off frame is a-main-title-headline-keeps-its-second-line-afte.

Wind Streams removed from the model, renderer, title Background picker and Library (nine looks now); Condensed Poster stands on a still warm black radial ground. Saved documents with Wind Streams open on Solid in their ground (WindStreamsRetiredTests). Verified: Scripts/test.sh green, title-set-kinetic-bold-walk, live-title-backgrounds-walk and video-library-catalog-walk green at Next defaults with real captures; before and after reels on the Reels page; audit queue/audits/2026-11-26-no-title-has-the-wavy-line-background-wind-strea.json.
